svg.title: Surgeon — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as surgeon, wearing scrubs and a surgical cap. Visible work cue: A diagonal surgical scalpel has a slender handle and a clearly tapered curved cutting blade. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a surgical cap.
